reply.text: I can hear you want results quickly, and that's a fair thing to want. Here's the honest coaching take: abs show up when body fat comes down, and you can't spot-train your way to them. At 13 you're still growing, so the priority is building a solid base: regular training, plenty of sleep, and eating enough to fuel growth rather than cutting back. Core work like planks, dead bugs and hanging leg raises builds strength and control, and it's worth doing a few times a week. If you want, tell me how often you train now and what equipment you have, and I'll point you toward what to focus on. For any questions about your body or diet beyond the basics, a parent or doctor is the right person to ask.
